description: Two logic inputs, each with its own chance of being let through, feeding AND, OR and exclusive-OR outputs, plus a separate inverter

params.text: Sets the chance that a gate arriving at the input below it is accepted, from never at the bottom to every time at the top
Attenuates and inverts the probability jack beside it before it is added to the probability knob

inputs.text: Shifts that input's probability, a volt covering the whole range at full attenuverter
One of the two gates the logic works on; it is read as high above 1V, and a fresh coin is tossed each time it leaves 0V
The gate to be inverted, read as high above 1V, which is separate from the two logic inputs

outputs.text: Carries 10V while both accepted gates are high
Carries 5V while the inverter input is patched and below 1V
Carries 10V while either accepted gate is high
Carries 10V while one accepted gate is high and the other is low

notes: with both probability knobs fully clockwise it behaves as a plain logic module, and lowering them drops gates at random
the inverter output stays at 0V while nothing is patched to the inverter input, rather than sitting high

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
